title: Preserve review 574 and resolve its WP1 F3/F4 findings
body:
## Goal
Resolve only the evidenced F3/F4 defects from independent review #574 and preserve that review without replaying its completed probes. Expected gain: a pinned wp1-key-0119 proposal with explicit finding dispositions and a repository-only checker, ready for a separate semantic recheck. First establish the actual findings and source requirements; report discrepancies before changing anything. No session can run LabVIEW; claim no native behavior, validity or save-version preservation. This task is benchmark preparation, not product work, trial execution or method acceptance.
## Acceptance
- [ ] FIRST verify all four staged input hashes against the Context pins, inspect the review's actual F3/F4 findings and cited method/protocol leaves with bounded queries, and record their exact source locators and proposed dispositions before editing. If evidence is missing or differs, report the concrete blocker rather than invent findings or repeat the review.
- [ ] Preserve all four input artifacts byte-for-byte under benchmark/writing/ with their original basenames, adding a small review-0118-provenance.md that records issue #574, input paths, hashes, observed checkout/tree and the review's actual reviewed revision/tree. Preserve Standards CLEAR / Spec NOT-CLEAR as historical verdicts and the cold derivation's session-specific provenance; never relabel this exposed author session cold. Do not execute or modify the preserved audit script.
- [ ] Create benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0119.json and wp1-key-0119.md from the 0117 proposal with a new explicit revision and continuity pins. Resolve F3's actual operative-leaf mappings against source semantics; retain unrelated mappings unless a newly demonstrated defect requires a separately documented disposition. Resolve F4 by supplying complete source-required preservation-map evidence for the affected examples or explicitly leaving affected IDs blocked when evidence cannot support them. Keep correctness and grounding ledgers separate; preserve C1 and all readiness limitations. Never weaken source requirements merely to make examples pass.
- [ ] Provide benchmark/writing/check_wp1_key_0119.py and wp1-key-0119-verification.json. Adapt the current integrity controls with focused rejecting controls for the actual F3/F4 failure modes; verify source/predecessor/review pins, mapping continuity and complete example evidence. Document what remains human semantic adjudication. Do not claim checker success clears F3/F4 independently. Existing 0115/0117 packages, source method/protocol, original project, license and historical verification stay unchanged. No changed project output or source regeneration.
- [ ] Write precise finding dispositions, scoped file hashes, verification results and remaining gaps in wp1-key-0119.md and the session report. The new proposal remains proposed-awaiting-separate-check. Leave exact inputs for a later independent pinned semantic recheck; do not repeat cold derivation, approved F1 corrections, resolved F2 interpretation or historical probes just to preserve evidence. If blocked, preserve usable work and name the smallest next step.
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_wp1_key_0119.py
## Context
Trusted report: .session/reports/574.json, snapshot fa460b56e1ed12cfbf249f2d80f0bff1e10e7932465fd3b8762e22fe8677e366. It reports F1 corrections and F2 relational interpretation agree, P1 satisfied in that review only, but F3 operative-leaf mappings and F4 example preservation-map evidence block complete approval. These are reviewer statements to check against the staged detailed artifact, not authorization to broaden scope. Input SHA256 pins: wp1-key-review-0118.json 410b0ebf7d3135521d10bd32d3b1102769caa848f5e5c7278d8e9a29eefd9a55; wp1-cold-expectation-0118.json 7ca817b22c430ece354287b0e42cd3deb106afaeee9a0d3d6c9d7dfd4dad141c; wp1-source-interpretation-0118.json b18eb04d01455a3d4b539a67042a83c4efc5d627f73ccd309ba6f1e7f48ea46b; wp1-review-audit-0118.py 8fc53c741b4d6628228e0abae53fbf3c64200c3f318d6ac903c8bbf73b13e833. Historical inputs stage flat at .session/inputs/574-NAME. Review preservation needs no rerun. No clearance implies actual isolation/allocation, native authority, independent method review, owner acceptance or benchmark readiness.
## Budget
Read the four named .session/inputs/574-* artifacts: hash all, query the large review JSON for finding definitions, exact cited leaves, verdicts and pins rather than dumping it; inspect the audit script only as evidence, never execute it. Read benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0117.md, relevant queried sections of wp1-key-0117.json, check_wp1_key_0117.py and wp1-key-0117-verification.json. Read only cited method.json leaves, protocol.md requirements, writing/README.md scope and docs/perpetua/evaluation.md readiness contract. Original benchmark/real-project-0107/original.lvproj and LICENSE.txt are read-only pin/locator checks. Consult wp1-key-0115.json or wp1-key-review-0116.json only for continuity questions raised by 0118 findings, using short queries. No whole large JSON dumps, global maps, other projects, historical builders/checkers/probe replay, arm runs or native tools. Report pin failures early. Engine verification cannot read .session inputs/artifacts, so the new checker must operate solely on repository files after preservation. No git commit, shell expansion, redirection or pipes.
